description: Verification plan of the llmchip vector engine (requirements FR-VER-04). Every item is executed by sim-verilator/verify; an item it does not know is reported as not executed.

items.description: Every evaluation prompt, 64 positions each: all observation points of L3 equal L2 bit for bit; the first divergence is localized to an operation and cycle
Reset in the middle of a step, then the sequence restarts from position 0 and matches L2
Generation from the BOS token alone matches the reference
A sequence filling the whole context matches the reference; a step beyond the context raises `error`
A position beyond the context or a token beyond the vocabulary ends the step with `error`
A start pulse with a different token and position while busy is ignored (the testbench pulses start inside every step)
The debug program traces every operation; all traces equal the instruction-level simulator
Rounding ties, saturation edges, table index edges and rsqrt normalization at powers of two
Sigmoid table index for every int16 input
Exp table index for every difference up to the cap
rsqrt normalization for every value up to 2^16
Random token sequences of the L2 trace, every position forced: all observation points of L3 equal L2
Line coverage of llmchip_core over two regression prompts, a mid-inference reset and illegal inputs
